# Transfer case output splines and yoke compatibility

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Verify the transfer case uses a 32 or 34 output spline and use an interchangeable t-case slip yoke. [t525]

## Tips & gotchas

- The t-case slip yoke should work interchangeably between models if they share the same transfer case design. [t525]
- A fixed rear yoke can be used to move the slip action entirely onto the driveshaft for better high-angle operation. [t525]
